_comment: The toolkit tree of the Android app (docs/android/prepare.md « Toolkit tree » and « When a pack is stale »): what android/app/build.gradle zips into assets/prepare/toolkit.zip, and what tools/prepare/toolkit.py hashes into the toolkit digest (pack.json toolkit_sha256). Ant patterns, relative to the repository root; one list of trees, each with its include and exclude patterns. The last exclude block repeats Gradle's default excludes so that both sides select the same files.
